originalTitle: Russian online retail warehouses hit by deadly Ukrainian strikes
title: Important News: Big Shops' Warehouses Hit Far Away
content:
Hello From Your Friendly Reporter!

Hello, my wonderful friends in Africa! It's your friendly news reporter here. Today, we have some news from very far away. Sometimes, grown-ups in different countries have big disagreements. This news is about something that happened during one of those big disagreements. It's important to learn about the world, even the sad parts, but remember we are safe here in Africa.

What Happened Far Away?

Imagine a very, very big building. This building is like a giant cupboard where an online shop keeps all its things. Things like toys, clothes, and yummy snacks! Well, far away in a country called Russia, some of these big storage buildings were hit. Sadly, when things like this happen, people can get hurt. This is always very sad news to hear. The big buildings belong to an online shop called Wildberries. It’s like a shop on the internet where people click to buy things, and then these things get sent to their homes.

What Are Drones?

Now, how were these big buildings hit? They were hit by something called "drones." Did you know? Drones are like small flying robots! Some drones are tiny, like little buzzing bees, and they can take cool pictures from high up in the sky. Other drones are bigger. They fly without a pilot sitting inside them. Grown-ups control them from far away, using a special remote control, just like you might fly a toy helicopter! These drones flew to the big buildings.

What Are Warehouses?

Let's talk more about those big buildings. We call them "warehouses." Did you know? A warehouse is like a super giant garage or a very, very big storage room! Think of your toy box. It holds all your toys, right? Now imagine a toy box so big it could hold hundreds or thousands of toy boxes! That's what a warehouse is. It's where shops keep all the things they want to sell. When you order something online, it usually comes from one of these big warehouses. They are super important for shops to send things quickly.

What is Wildberries?

So, the warehouses that were hit belong to a shop called Wildberries. Did you know? Wildberries is one of the biggest online shops in its country! It's a place where many people go on their computers or phones to buy things. They can buy new shoes, cool books, warm jackets, or even gifts for their family. Then, Wildberries sends these items from their big warehouses right to the people's homes. It helps many families get the things they need and want without leaving their houses.

Where Did This Happen?

These events happened very far away from us, in places called near "Moscow" and in a town called "Tambov." Did you know? Moscow is a very famous city in Russia, just like Cairo is a famous city in Egypt, or Nairobi in Kenya! These places are in Russia, a country that is very, very far from Africa. It’s on a different continent. So, while we hear about it, it is not happening near us.

Why Did This Happen?

This is a bit tricky, but I will try to explain simply. Grown-up leaders in a country called Ukraine said that these big warehouses were holding special parts. These parts were things that some other countries had said should not be sent to Russia. We call these "rules" or "bans" on selling things "sanctions." Did you know? Sanctions are like a grown-up rule that says "please don't buy or sell *this* thing to *that* person or country." These rules are put in place when countries have very big disagreements, like the one happening now between Russia and Ukraine. The leader of Ukraine, a grown-up named Mr. Zelenskyy, said these warehouses were helping to move those special parts. So, that's why these places were targeted. It's part of the big and sad disagreement between these two countries.

What Does This Mean for Us?

This news is happening far, far away. It doesn't mean that shops in Africa will stop delivering your toys or books. Our homes and our countries are safe. Did you know? Africa is a very big continent with many wonderful countries! It's just important to know what is happening in the world, so we can understand different things when grown-ups talk about them. We hope that one day, all the disagreements in the world will stop, and everyone can live in peace.

Let's Be Kind

Even when we hear sad news from far away, it reminds us that being kind is super important. Being kind to our friends, our family, and even people we don't know, can help make the world a better place. Let's remember to be good neighbors and friends, just like we always are. We hope for peace for everyone, everywhere.
summary: Big storage buildings for an online shop in Russia were hit by flying robots called drones, due to a big grown-up disagreement far away.
whyMatters: It's important to know what's happening in the world, even far away, and to remember that disagreements between grown-ups can have sad results, reminding us to always choose peace and kindness.

originalTitle: Many Ukrainian soldiers outraged over removal of defence minister, troops tell BBC
title: Big Changes for Brave Soldiers Far Away in Ukraine!
content:
Hello, my super friends! It’s me, your news buddy from Africa, ready to share some important news with you in a super simple way! Today, we're going to talk about something happening far, far away in a country called Ukraine.

Hello from Your African News Buddy!

Imagine I'm sitting here with you, under a big, beautiful African sky. We love to learn about our world, right? Well, today we are going to learn about a place called Ukraine. It's very far from us, across many oceans and lands. In Ukraine, people are going through a really tough time. They are in a big argument, almost like a very, very big family disagreement, but much bigger and with soldiers.

What's Happening in Ukraine?

In Ukraine, brave soldiers are working hard every single day. They are like superheroes protecting their home and their families. They wear uniforms and train a lot to keep their country safe. It’s a very important job, full of courage. Did you know? Ukraine is a country in Europe. It has many beautiful cities and fields, just like some places here in Africa! But right now, it's not peaceful there.

Who is a Defence Minister?

Every big team needs a good leader, right? Think of your school's football team or your community’s dance group. They have a leader or a coach. In a country, especially when it needs protecting, there's a very important person called a "Defence Minister." This person is like the head coach for all the soldiers. They help make big plans to keep the country safe. They talk to the soldiers and make sure they have what they need to do their job well. Mykhailo Fedorov was this important person, the Defence Minister, in Ukraine. He was the head coach for the Ukrainian soldiers.

A Big Change Happened

Now, imagine your favorite coach for your school team suddenly left. How would you feel? Maybe a bit surprised, maybe a bit sad, or even a little worried about who would be the new coach. Well, something like that just happened in Ukraine. Mykhailo Fedorov, the Defence Minister, was "removed." This means he was asked to leave his job. He is not the head coach anymore. This big change happened on a Thursday. When big changes happen, people often have many feelings.

People Are Showing They Are Unhappy

When many people in a place are unhappy about something important, they sometimes show it together. This is called a "protest." It's when people gather to say, "Hey! We don't like this decision!" or "We want things to be different!" They might carry signs or talk loudly. It's their way of letting leaders know how they feel. In Ukraine, after Mr. Fedorov was removed, some people started to protest. They were showing that they were not happy with this decision. It's like many people saying, "Boo!" all at once. Did you know? Protesting is a way for people to use their voices and show their feelings in a big group. It's important for people to be able to share what they think!

Soldiers Also Have Feelings

You might think soldiers are always tough and don't show feelings. But that's not true! Soldiers are people, just like you and me. They have feelings too. And when big changes happen to their leaders, it affects them a lot. The news tells us that the Ukrainian soldiers are now "criticising" this decision. What does "criticising" mean? It means they are saying they don't agree with the decision. They are saying they don't like that their Defence Minister, Mr. Fedorov, was removed. It's like if your football team members said, "We don't agree with the coach leaving!"

Why Are the Soldiers Unhappy?

Think about it. These soldiers are in a very difficult time, protecting their country. They work closely with their leader, the Defence Minister. They might have trusted Mr. Fedorov. They might have believed in his plans. When a leader they trust is suddenly gone, it can make them feel worried. They might wonder, "What will happen next?" or "Who will lead us now?" It's a big deal when the person who plans how to keep everyone safe is changed, especially when the country is already facing big challenges. The soldiers depend on their leaders to guide them. Did you know? Trust is very important between leaders and their teams, especially in a country that needs protection.

What Happens Next?

When soldiers, who are so important for a country's safety, feel unhappy about a big decision, it's something people pay attention to. It means that the leaders of Ukraine will need to listen carefully to what their soldiers are saying. They will need to explain things and make sure everyone feels supported. It's a reminder that even in very big and serious situations, everyone's feelings matter. From the people protesting in the streets to the brave soldiers on the front lines.

Working Together for a Better Tomorrow

Here in Africa, we always hope for peace and understanding for everyone around the world. Even when there are disagreements or big changes, it’s always best when people can talk to each other and try to understand each other's feelings. These brave soldiers in Ukraine continue to do their best for their country, even with these big changes happening. We hope that they can continue to feel strong and supported. So, my amazing friends, remember that leaders have big jobs, and people always have feelings about what happens in their country. It’s important to always be kind and listen to each other. Keep learning, keep asking questions, and keep shining bright! Your African news buddy is always here to share the world with you. Bye for now!
summary: Brave soldiers in a country called Ukraine are feeling sad and worried because their important leader, the Defence Minister, has left his job, and many people are showing they are not happy about it.
whyMatters: It's important because soldiers help keep their country safe, and when big changes happen to their leaders, it can make them worried, so we should hope for everyone to feel safe and happy.
